Barrett-Jackson group transportation

A Barrett-Jackson ride from Scottsdale Sprinters starts with the official 2027 page, a realistic rider count and one transportation lead. Collector and corporate hospitality groups lead with the executive Sprinters, the Maybach and, for a larger party, the motorcoach. This guide uses only published organizer facts, leaves unannounced details for closer to the date, and turns each day into a written pickup, arrival and return plan.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

When is Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale 2027?

Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale runs Saturday, January 23 through Sunday, January 31, 2027, which is 9 public days at WestWorld of Scottsdale, with gates, food courts and sponsor displays open from 8:00 a.m. until auction close, plus an invitation-only Opening Night Gala on Friday, January 22, 2027, from 7:00 to 10:00 p.m. Use the Barrett-Jackson 2027 Scottsdale page as the date authority. The City of Scottsdale WestWorld calendar lists the same Saturday, January 23 through Sunday, January 31 window. The city calendar shows a 10:00 a.m. start; the organizer’s own schedule says gates, food courts and sponsor displays open at 8:00 a.m. until auction close every day of those 9 days. Plan departures from the organizer’s 8:00 a.m. gate time, and recheck that page before the service day. The Opening Night Gala is Friday, January 22, 2027, from 7:00 to 10:00 p.m., by invitation only in the Auction Arena. It is not a public gate day. A group attending the gala needs its own invitation and a separate service window from the public days that start the next morning. Do not treat January 22 as a day the general-admission crowd can enter. The organizer says 2027 is 9 days of live auction action, with over 2,000 collector vehicles on display, an exhibitor marketplace, thrill rides and more. Daily auction close times, and which days the docket runs, are announced closer to the date. The venue map, travel notes, featured list and sponsors tab are also announced closer to the date. Mark those as open items rather than copying a prior year’s schedule. A quote can still name the city, the hotel area, the rider count and whether the group is attending one day or several of the 9. Unannounced close times stay placeholders until Barrett-Jackson publishes them. The reservations team updates the service window from that page, not from a recycled itinerary.

Which vehicle fits a Barrett-Jackson collector or hospitality group?

Collector and hospitality groups start with the Executive Black Sprinter and the Maybach Jet Sprinter, then the 56-Passenger Motorcoach when one vehicle has to carry a larger party; the table lists 8 executive sizes, and a celebration vehicle is a secondary request only, never the lead choice for this auction. The table uses current published names, seated capacities, hourly rates and minimums. The Executive Black Sprinter seats 14 at $145 per hour. The Maybach Jet Sprinter is the VIP cabin for a smaller collector or host group. The 56-Passenger Motorcoach seats 56 when a hospitality tent, a dealer group or a multi-family party needs one vehicle. Larger than that, the reservations team quotes coordinated executive vehicles rather than a celebration unit. Count riders for each direction. A morning arrival at the 8:00 a.m. gate and an evening return after auction close are often different lists. Someone who leaves with another host, or who stays for a later lot, should come off the return manifest before seats are assigned. “We will decide at the arena” is not a useful count when the grounds are releasing traffic. A celebration vehicle — a party Sprinter or similar — is secondary at most, and only when the group is traveling to celebrate rather than to move collectors or a corporate host party. It is not in the table on this page. Tell the reservations team which job the vehicle is doing so the written quote uses the executive sizes first. Tell the reservations team what the group will carry before the vehicle is chosen. The organizer checks every bag and screens guests. A clear bag that the gate allows can still take a seat or an aisle. Seat counts are seated capacities, not a promise that coolers, display materials or extra coats will fit. Coolers are prohibited on the grounds.

How should a group arrive at WestWorld for Barrett-Jackson?

Plan 1 documented arrival at WestWorld of Scottsdale, 16601 North Pima Road, Scottsdale, AZ 85260, using the organizer’s complimentary public parking and main-gate shuttles or the paid valet; a limo, charter or commercial drop-off zone is announced closer to the date, so this guide does not name a gate the page has not published. Barrett-Jackson publishes plenty of complimentary public parking. Follow the road signs to parking. Shuttles run to and from the Scottsdale auction’s main gate. Valet parking is available for a fee. That is the official parking plan: complimentary public parking with shuttles, plus paid valet. It is not a statement that a booked commercial vehicle may unload at the arena door. Rideshare drop-off and pick-up use the parking lot west of Thompson Peak Parkway on McDowell Mountain Ranch Road. Follow the signs to the rideshare area. That lot is the published rideshare point. It is not, by itself, a commercial-vehicle privilege. A chauffeured coach or Sprinter still needs the current event instruction, which for a limo, charter or commercial drop-off is announced closer to the date. No city traffic plan or Pima Road closure list for 2027 is published yet. Those controls are announced closer to the date. Until then the address is the routing anchor: 16601 North Pima Road, Scottsdale, AZ 85260. If Barrett-Jackson or the city later publishes a credential, a lot or a loading lane, that current instruction replaces this general address for the booked vehicle. Build the buffer before the group wants to be inside, not merely before the property line. Gates open at 8:00 a.m. Loading, the approach, security screening and the walk from the authorized unload point all take time. The vehicle cannot bypass traffic staff, and the group should not ask to unload in a travel lane because the schedule ran tight.

What should the Barrett-Jackson day plan include?

Write 7 lines into the Barrett-Jackson day plan: guest ready time, vehicle departure, the 8:00 a.m. gate target, a primary contact, the WestWorld address, the return meeting rule, and a final roll time, and keep meals or client entertainment on separate lines so riders can see what actually moves the vehicle. A public day runs from the 8:00 a.m. gate until auction close. Auction close itself is announced closer to the date, so the return clock stays a placeholder until the organizer publishes that day’s end. Work backward from the arrival the group wants, add loading time, and do not print one drive time for every Scottsdale hotel. Origin, day of week and event operations all change it. The ready time is when guests are at the pickup point with tickets, identification and the bag they will carry through screening. It is not the moment they start getting dressed. The transportation lead arrives earlier, checks the manifest and calls anyone missing. Decide in advance who may hold the vehicle and for how long. Most of the site is climate-controlled. The Performance Track thrill rides and hot laps are outdoors, for ages 8 and up or guests at least 48 inches tall. If the group includes children who will ride, say so on the itinerary so the return is not planned around an activity they cannot enter. General-admission tickets are sold online and at the on-site AXS box office, and general admission does not guarantee arena seating. One contingency line belongs on the sheet: if the group splits, each rider follows the written meeting instruction and contacts the transportation lead. Do not create several competing pins during the auction. A single approved plan is easier to run when the grounds are busy and cellular service is uneven.

How should pickup after Barrett-Jackson work?

Use 2 checkpoints after Barrett-Jackson: the group gathers first at a pedestrian point the current instructions allow, then the transportation lead confirms the vehicle’s active pickup before anyone walks toward traffic, because a commercial loading lane is announced closer to the date and the arrival curb may not be the departure curb. The published rideshare lot, west of Thompson Peak Parkway on McDowell Mountain Ranch Road, is the official place rideshare guests request a car. A booked Sprinter, Maybach or motorcoach follows venue staff and the instruction confirmed for that vehicle. Guests should not walk into a roadway to chase a phone pin. The lead keeps the headcount and waits for a confirmed place to move. Set the expectation before arrival. The vehicle cannot stop wherever a pin lands, and event traffic staff control access. Comfortable shoes matter for the walk from the shuttle or the authorized curb. Anyone leaving separately tells the transportation lead so the return manifest stays accurate. For more than one return wave, label the vehicle, the lead and the hotel. A collector group heading to one resort and a hospitality group heading to another should not rely on recognizing a driver in a crowd. The final sweep checks the manifest before the vehicle rolls, rather than waiting on people who changed plans without notice.

What can guests bring, and what is the gate like?

The 2027 gate allows 3 bag shapes: a clutch up to 6.5 by 4.5 inches, a clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a 1-gallon clear bag, and every bag is checked while guests are screened; weapons, video cameras, skateboards, drones, coolers and animals are prohibited, with licensed service animals allowed. One sealed water bottle under 17 ounces per person is the published drink allowance. The event is cashless except for certain food concessions and valet parking. Bring the payment method those concessions and the valet booth will take, and do not plan to pay the gate or a food stand with cash unless that stand is one of the exceptions the organizer names. Admission is separate from transportation. General-admission tickets are sold online and at the on-site AXS box office. General admission does not guarantee a seat in the arena. Buy and verify tickets only through Barrett-Jackson’s official channels. A vehicle booking does not include a credential, a parking pass or an invitation to the January 22 gala. If an allowed-items rule changes, the organizer’s current page replaces this summary. Send the reservations team the exact list the group will carry so vehicle fit can be reviewed against that list. Something the gate permits can still be a poor fit in the cabin.

How far ahead should Barrett-Jackson transportation be requested?

Availability for Barrett-Jackson varies by date and by vehicle, so no fixed lead time applies: request a current quote with the rider count, hotel area and which of the 9 days you need, and the reservations team confirms what is open across the 8 executive sizes, updating the plan as Barrett-Jackson announces the remaining details closer to the date. The first request needs the days, the lodging or pickup area, the likely passenger count, the desired arrival against the 8:00 a.m. gate, and the return concept. A group does not need every name to begin. It does need to separate committed riders from possible ones, and to say whether the movement is collectors, a corporate host party, or a secondary celebration request. Once the group is committed, close the manifest and collect mobility needs and the bags that will go through screening. Confirm that every rider has an admission plan of their own. If the docket, the auction close or the commercial loading lane is still announced closer to the date, leave that line open and name one person to recheck the official page. During the final 48 hours, verify addresses, contact numbers and the newest Barrett-Jackson directions. Send one summary to riders. If staff change the approach on the day, the chauffeur follows them and the transportation lead relays the update. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. An older screenshot does not outrank the current control.

How is Barrett-Jackson transportation priced per person?

For 12 Barrett-Jackson riders sharing the Executive Black Sprinter across 5 billed hours, the published $145-per-hour rate is about $60 per person before tax for the complete shared ride; actual pricing changes with the vehicle, the duration, the itinerary and the confirmed service plan. That example is arithmetic, not a flat auction fare: hourly rate multiplied by billed hours, divided by riders. If only ten people ride, divide across ten. If the group needs the motorcoach or a longer window that waits through auction close, request that calculation instead of stretching the 5-hour illustration. A complete plan may be a continuous vehicle, separate inbound and outbound transfers, or several hotel waves across the 9 days. Each shape uses time differently. Describe the actual pattern. A many-hour gap between drop-off and pickup is not a round trip until the quote says how those hours are billed. The same arithmetic on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach uses its own published rate of $325 per hour and its own seated capacity of 56. Per-person math is useful after the rider list settles. One person collects shares and one person owns the manifest. Neither job belongs to the chauffeur.

Frequently asked questions

Does a transportation booking include Barrett-Jackson admission?

No. General-admission tickets, arena seating, valet and the invitation-only Opening Night Gala are separate. Buy tickets online or at the on-site AXS box office, and verify them only through Barrett-Jackson.

What does Barrett-Jackson publish about public parking?

The organizer publishes plenty of complimentary public parking, with shuttles to and from the main gate. Valet parking is available for a fee. Follow the road signs to parking.

Where do rideshares drop off at Barrett-Jackson?

Use the parking lot west of Thompson Peak Parkway on McDowell Mountain Ranch Road and follow the signs to the rideshare area. A chauffeured commercial drop-off zone is announced closer to the date.

Can the vehicle wait next to the auction arena?

Only where current event operations permit it. A limo, charter or commercial loading lane is announced closer to the date, so the chauffeur follows venue staff and the transportation lead shares the confirmed meeting plan.

What if the auction close time is still unpublished?

Daily auction close times are announced closer to the date. The transportation lead contacts the reservations team when Barrett-Jackson publishes them. A revised return is not assumed until the updated plan is confirmed.
